220    _COUNTS_ARTIFACT = "measurement_counts"
221    _MEAS_ARTIFACT = "measurements"
222
223    def __init__(
224        self,
225        backend: QBackend,
226        heappe_job_id: int,
227        submitted_job: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
228        job_type: str = "circuit",
229        shots: int | None = None,
230        memory: bool = False,
231        circuit_headers: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
232    ):
233        """Initialize the QJob.
234
235        Args:
236            backend (QBackend): The backend associated with this job.
237            heappe_job_id (int): The HEAppE job ID.
238            submitted_job (dict[str, Any] | None): The submitted job details.
239            job_type (str): The type of job, default is "circuit".
240            shots (int | None): The number of shots for the job.
241            memory (bool): The ``memory`` option passed to ``backend.run()``. If True,
242                :meth:`result` includes per-shot results.
243            circuit_headers (list[dict[str, Any]] | None): ``{"name", "metadata"}`` of each
244                circuit, set by ``backend.run()``. Without it (a job re-created from its
245                id), result experiments are named ``circuit-<i>`` with empty metadata.
246        """
247        super().__init__(backend, str(heappe_job_id))
248        self.job_id = _HEAppEJobId(heappe_job_id)
249        self._backend: QBackend = backend
250        self._qclient: QClient = backend._qclient
251        self._submitted_job = submitted_job or {"Id": heappe_job_id}
252        self._shots = shots if shots is not None else backend.options.shots
253        self._memory = memory
254        self.remote_job = None
255        self._cancel_requested = False
256        self._last_known_status: str = "SUBMITTED"
257        self._cached_raw_results = None
258        self._artifacts: dict[str, Any] | None = None
259        self._artifacts_have_measurements = False
260        self._result: Result | None = None
261        self._circuit_headers = circuit_headers
262
263    def status(self) -> JobStatus:
264        """Queries HEAppE job status via QClient and maps it to Qiskit JobStatus.
265
266        HEAppE is queried on every call until the job reaches a terminal state.
267
268        Returns:
269            JobStatus: The current status of the job.
270        """
271        if self.remote_job:
272            return self.remote_job.status()
273
274        if self._cancel_requested:
275            return JobStatus.CANCELLED
276
277        if self._last_known_status.upper() not in self._qclient.TERMINAL_JOB_STATES:
278            self._refresh_job_info()
279
280        return self._to_qiskit_status(self._last_known_status.upper())
281
282    def _to_qiskit_status(self, heappe_status: str) -> JobStatus:
283        """Maps a HEAppE status string to Qiskit JobStatus, handling explicit cancellations.
284
285        Args:
286            heappe_status (str): The HEAppE status string.
287
288        Returns:
289            JobStatus: The corresponding Qiskit JobStatus.
290        """
291        status = HEAppE_QISKIT_STATUS_MAPPING.get(heappe_status, JobStatus.ERROR)
292        if self._cancel_requested and status is JobStatus.ERROR:
293            return JobStatus.CANCELLED
294        return status
295
296    def _get_artifacts(self, with_measurements: bool) -> dict[str, Any]:
297        """Download artifacts once; re-download only if measurements are newly requested.
298
299        Args:
300            with_measurements (bool): If True, download measurements as well.
301
302        Returns:
303            dict[str, Any]: The downloaded artifacts.
304        """
305        if self._artifacts is not None and (
306            self._artifacts_have_measurements or not with_measurements
307        ):
308            return self._artifacts
309
310        names = [QJob._COUNTS_ARTIFACT] + (
311            [QJob._MEAS_ARTIFACT] if with_measurements else []
312        )
313        self._cached_raw_results = self._qclient.get_job_results(
314            self._submitted_job, artifact_names=names
315        )
316
317        self._artifacts = self._cached_raw_results[self.job_id].get("artifacts", {})
318        self._artifacts_have_measurements = with_measurements
319        return self._artifacts
320
321    def result(self) -> Result:
322        """Wait for the job and return its result as a :class:`qiskit.result.Result`.
323
324        Returns a ``Result``, as ``JobV1.result()`` requires, so tools that take a
325        backend (``BackendSamplerV2``, ``BackendEstimatorV2``, ``qiskit-experiments``)
326        work unchanged. For ``PrimitiveResult`` output, use :class:`QSamplerV2`.
327
328        Per-shot results (``res.get_memory()``) are included when the job was submitted
329        with ``backend.run(..., memory=True)`` (or created with ``QJob(..., memory=True)``).
330        Bitstrings follow the Qiskit order: registers in circuit order, clbit 0 rightmost.
331
332        Returns:
333            Result: The result of the circuit execution:
334            ``res.get_counts()`` (counts), ``res.get_memory()`` (per-shot results).
335
336        Raises:
337            RuntimeError: If the job fails or is canceled.
338            ValueError: If the number of raw results does not match the number of measurement sets.
339        """
340        if self._result is not None:
341            return self._result
342
343        artifacts = self._finished_artifacts(self._memory)
344        self._result = self._backend.result_to_qiskit_legacy(
345            artifacts.get(QJob._COUNTS_ARTIFACT, []),
346            measurements_raw=artifacts.get(QJob._MEAS_ARTIFACT)
347            if self._memory
348            else None,
349            backend_name=self._backend.name,
350            job_id=self._job_id,  # plain str stored by JobV1
351            circuit_headers=self._circuit_headers,
352        )
353        return self._result
354
355    def _finished_artifacts(self, with_measurements: bool) -> dict[str, Any]:
356        """Wait until the job finishes, then return its downloaded artifacts.
357
358        Args:
359            with_measurements (bool): Also download per-shot measurements.
360
361        Returns:
362            dict[str, Any]: Artifacts by name (``measurement_counts``, ``measurements``).
363
364        Raises:
365            RuntimeError: If the job fails, is canceled, or returned no per-shot
366                measurements when they were requested.
367        """
368        try:
369            final_status = self._wait_for_terminal_state()
370        except Exception as e:
371            if self._cancel_requested:
372                raise RuntimeError(f"Job {self.job_id()} was canceled.") from e
373            raise RuntimeError(f"Job {self.job_id()} failed: {e!s}") from e
374
375        if final_status.upper() not in ["FINISHED", "DONE"]:
376            if self._cancel_requested or final_status.upper() == "CANCELED":
377                raise RuntimeError(f"Job {self.job_id()} was canceled.")
378            raise RuntimeError(
379                f"Job {self.job_id()} failed with status: {final_status}"
380            )
381
382        artifacts = self._get_artifacts(with_measurements=with_measurements)
383        if with_measurements and artifacts.get(QJob._MEAS_ARTIFACT) is None:
384            raise RuntimeError(
385                f"Job {self.job_id()}: backend returned no per-shot measurements."
386            )
387        return artifacts
388
389    def _refresh_job_info(self) -> str:
390        """Fetch the current job info from HEAppE and store it.
391
392        If HEAppE returns no ``State``, the last known state is kept.
393
394        Returns:
395            str: The job state, e.g. ``"RUNNING"`` or ``"FINISHED"``.
396        """
397        info = self._qclient.get_job_info(self.job_id())
398        if info.get("State") is not None:
399            self._submitted_job = info
400            self._last_known_status = HEAppEJobState.readable(info["State"])
401        return self._last_known_status
402
403    def _wait_for_terminal_state(self) -> str:
404        """Return the job's terminal state, waiting for it if needed.
405
406        Uses a terminal state already seen (by :meth:`status` or an earlier wait).
407        Otherwise asks HEAppE first, so a job that already finished is not waited on:
408        the event stream does not report state changes that happened before it opened.
409        After waiting, the job info is fetched again, so ``_submitted_job`` holds the
410        final ``State`` and ``Tasks``.
411
412        Returns:
413            str: Terminal state, e.g. ``"FINISHED"``.
414        """
415        terminal = self._qclient.TERMINAL_JOB_STATES
416        if self._last_known_status.upper() in terminal:
417            return self._last_known_status
418        self.wait_for_final_state()
419        final = self._last_known_status
420        if self._refresh_job_info().upper() not in terminal:
421            # Job info can lag behind the event stream (still SUBMITTED for a few
422            # seconds after the job finished), so keep the final state already seen.
423            self._last_known_status = final
424        return self._last_known_status
425
426    def wait_for_final_state(
427        self,
428        timeout: float | None = None,
429        wait: float = 5,
430        callback: Callable | None = None,
431    ) -> None:
432        """Wait until the job reaches a final state such as ``DONE`` or ``ERROR``.
433
434        Same interface as ``JobV1.wait_for_final_state``, but follows the HEAppE event
435        websocket instead of polling. Job info is still fetched every ``wait`` seconds
436        as a backup, because the websocket only reports state changes that happen
437        after it connects (and may close early).
438
439        Args:
440            timeout (float | None): Seconds to wait for the job. If ``None``, wait
441                indefinitely.
442            wait (float): Seconds between backup job-info queries.
443            callback (Callable | None): Called as ``callback(job_id, job_status, job)``
444                with the current status before waiting and on each status change
445                that is not final.
446
447        Raises:
448            JobTimeoutError: If the job does not reach a final state before the
449                specified timeout.
450        """
451        if self.remote_job:
452            self.remote_job.wait_for_final_state(timeout=timeout, callback=callback)
453            return
454        status = self.status()
455        if status in JOB_FINAL_STATES:
456            return
457        if callback:
458            callback(self.job_id(), status, self)
459        try:
460            self._qclient._run(self._await_final_state(timeout, wait, callback, status))
461        except TimeoutError:
462            raise JobTimeoutError(
463                f"Timeout while waiting for job {self.job_id()}."
464            ) from None
465
466    async def _await_final_state(
467        self,
468        timeout: float | None,
469        wait: float,
470        callback: Callable | None,
471        status: JobStatus,
472    ) -> None:
473        """Follow the event websocket, with a job-info query every ``wait`` seconds.
474
475        Args:
476            timeout (float | None): Maximum wait in seconds; unlimited if ``None``.
477            wait (float): Seconds between backup job-info queries.
478            callback (Callable | None): See :meth:`wait_for_final_state`.
479            status (JobStatus): The last status already reported to ``callback``.
480
481        Raises:
482            TimeoutError: The job did not reach a final state in time.
483        """
484        last = [status]
485
486        def update(state: str) -> bool:
487            """Record a HEAppE state; True once it is final."""
488            self._last_known_status = state.upper()
489            new = self._to_qiskit_status(self._last_known_status)
490            if new in JOB_FINAL_STATES:
491                return True
492            if new != last[0]:
493                last[0] = new
494                if callback:
495                    callback(self.job_id(), new, self)
496            return False
497
498        async def from_events() -> None:
499            try:
500                async with aclosing(self._qclient.iter_events()) as events:
501                    async for event in events:
502                        data = event.get("data") or {}
503                        job_id, state = data.get("jobId"), data.get("state")
504                        if job_id is None or int(job_id) != int(self.job_id):
505                            continue
506                        if state and update(str(state)):
507                            return
508            except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001 - fall back to job-info queries
509                log.debug("Event stream for job %s failed: %s", self.job_id, e)
510            await asyncio.Event().wait()  # stream gone: rely on job-info queries
511
512        async def from_job_info() -> None:
513            while True:
514                await asyncio.sleep(wait)
515                state = (await self._qclient.aget_job_info(int(self.job_id))).get(
516                    "State"
517                )
518                if state is not None and update(HEAppEJobState.readable(state)):
519                    return
520
521        tasks = [
522            asyncio.create_task(from_events()),
523            asyncio.create_task(from_job_info()),
524        ]
525        try:
526            async with asyncio.timeout(timeout):
527                done, _ = await asyncio.wait(tasks, return_when=asyncio.FIRST_COMPLETED)
528            for task in done:
529                task.result()  # surface errors from the finished source
530        finally:
531            for task in tasks:
532                task.cancel()
533            await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)
534
535    def submit(self) -> None:
536        """Submission is performed directly inside QBackend.run()."""
537
538    def cancel(self) -> bool:
539        """Ask HEAppE to cancel the job.
540
541        Returns:
542            bool: ``True`` if HEAppE accepted the request; :meth:`status` then reports
543            ``JobStatus.CANCELLED``. ``False`` if it was refused (the error is logged).
544        """
545        accepted = bool(self._qclient._run(self._qclient.cancel_job(int(self.job_id))))
546        if accepted:
547            self._cancel_requested = True
548        return accepted

QaaS Job class inheriting from Qiskit's JobV1.

104class QProvider:
105    """QaaS wrapper for IQM backends with LEXIS token authentication.
106
107    Manages client connections and provides access to quantum computing resources.
108    Each resource gets its own cached client that authenticates once and maintains
109    machine information for all clusters of that resource. Backend instances are
110    created by binding clients to specific backend names.
111
112    Attributes:
113        _lexis_project: The Lexis project identifier.
114        _token: Authentication token (auto-generated if not provided).
115        _provider_token: Optional provider access token.
116        _lexis_api_url: Base URL for Lexis API requests.
117        _clients: Dictionary mapping resource names to QClient instances.
118    """
119
120    def __init__(
121        self,
122        lexis_project: str,
123        token: str | None = None,
124        provider_access_token=None,
125        lexis_api_url: str = DEFAULT_LEXIS_API_URL,
126    ):
127        """Initialize the QProvider with Lexis credentials.
128
129        Args:
130            lexis_project: The Lexis project identifier.
131            token: Optional authentication token. If not provided, will be auto-generated.
132            provider_access_token: Optional provider access token.
133            lexis_api_url: Base URL for Lexis API requests (default: DEFAULT_LEXIS_API_URL).
134        """
135        self._lexis_project = lexis_project
136        self._token = token
137        self._provider_token = provider_access_token
138        self._lexis_api_url = lexis_api_url
139        self._clients: dict[str | None, QClient] = {}
140
141        # Create a new event loop for async operations
142        self._event_loop = asyncio.new_event_loop()
143
144        # Auto-generate token if not provided
145        if self._token is None:
146            from py4lexis.session import LexisSession
147
148            self._session = LexisSession()
149            self._token = self._session.get_access_token()
150        else:
151            self._session = None
152
153    def _get_client(
154        self, lexis_resource_name: str | None, **client_kwargs: Any
155    ) -> QClient:
156        """Get or create a cached QClient for the specified resource.
157
158        Args:
159            lexis_resource_name: The Lexis resource name (None for auto-selection).
160            client_kwargs: Additional keyword arguments to pass to QClient constructor.
161
162        Returns:
163            QClient: Authenticated client instance bound to the resource.
164
165        Notes:
166            - Clients are cached per resource and reused if no additional kwargs are provided.
167            - New clients with extra kwargs aren't cached for better isolation.
168        """
169        if not client_kwargs:
170            cached = self._clients.get(lexis_resource_name)
171            if cached is not None and cached.is_authenticated:
172                return cached
173
174        # Create new client with authentication and machine info loading
175        client = QClient(
176            self._token,
177            self._lexis_project,
178            lexis_resource_name,
179            self._provider_token,
180            lexis_api_url=self._lexis_api_url,
181            **client_kwargs,
182        )
183        client.connect()  # authenticate and load machine info
184
185        if not client_kwargs:
186            # None (auto-selected) and explicit name share one client
187            self._clients[lexis_resource_name] = client
188            self._clients[client.lexis_resource.resource_name] = client
189        return client
190
191    def clear_cache(self) -> None:
192        """Clear all cached QClient instances.
193
194        Useful after token refresh or when cleaning up resources.
195        """
196        self._clients.clear()

269    def get_backend(
270        self,
271        lexis_resource: str | QBackendMetadata | None = None,
272        backend_name: str | None = None,
273        calibration_set_id: UUID | None = None,
274        *,
275        use_metrics: bool = False,
276        strict_iqm_version: bool = True,
277        **client_kwargs: Any,
278    ) -> QBackend:
279        """Create a QBackend instance bound to the specified resource and backend.
280
281        For IQM, the backend class is picked by :class:`QBackendIQMFactory` from the
282        installed iqm-client and the station-control version the backend reports.
283
284        Args:
285            lexis_resource: Either resource name or QBackendMetadata object.
286            backend_name: Optional backend name to specify if not using metadata.
287            calibration_set_id: Optional calibration set ID for specific backend state.
288            use_metrics: Whether to enable metrics collection (default: False).
289            strict_iqm_version: Raise if the installed IQM libraries do not match the
290                backend; if ``False``, only warn (default: True).
291            client_kwargs: Additional keyword arguments for client initialization.
292
293        Returns:
294            QBackendIQM: Configured backend instance for quantum operations
295            (``QBackendIQM35`` or ``QBackendIQM36``).
296
297        Raises:
298            NotImplementedError: If software stack is not 'iqm'.
299            ValueError: For missing dynamic/static architecture requirements.
300            QException: Installed IQM libraries do not match the backend.
301        """
302        resource_name, name = _split_target(lexis_resource, backend_name)
303        client = self._get_client(resource_name, **client_kwargs).bind(name)
304        backend_metadata = client.get_quantum_backend_info(
305            backend_name=name, calibration_set_id=calibration_set_id
306        )
307        _require_iqm(backend_metadata)
308
309        return QBackendIQMFactory.create(
310            client,
311            backend_metadata,
312            calibration_set_id,
313            use_metrics=use_metrics,
314            strict=strict_iqm_version,
315        )
316
317    def get_pulla(
318        self,
319        lexis_resource: str | QBackendMetadata | None = None,
320        backend_name: str | None = None,
321        calibration_set_id: UUID | None = None,
322        *,
323        strict_iqm_version: bool = True,
324        walltime_limit_secs: int = 3600,
325        job_name: str = "qpulla_job",
326        use_sessions: bool = False,
327        **client_kwargs: Any,
328    ) -> QPulla:
329        """Get pulse-level access (IQM Pulla) to a backend.
330
331        The returned :class:`~qheappe_client.qpulla.QPulla` is an
332        :class:`iqm.iqm_client.IQMClient` connected through HEAppE: compile with
333        ``get_standard_compiler()`` / ``qiskit_to_iqm()`` and run with
334        ``submit_playlist()``, as in IQM's Pulla documentation. Its ``backend`` is the
335        Qiskit backend of the same machine.
336
337        Needs the IQM 36 stack (``qaas[iqm_qiskit]``), QScheduler v0.2.2+ with pulse
338        access enabled for the machine, and HEAppE 6.7.0+.
339
340        Args:
341            lexis_resource: Either resource name or QBackendMetadata object.
342            backend_name: Optional backend name to specify if not using metadata.
343            calibration_set_id: Calibration set of the Qiskit backend (transpilation);
344                current if ``None``.
345            strict_iqm_version: Raise if the installed IQM libraries do not match the
346                backend; if ``False``, only warn (default: True).
347            walltime_limit_secs: HEAppE walltime limit of each submitted task.
348            job_name: HEAppE job name of submitted jobs.
349            use_sessions: Run submitted tasks in QScheduler sessions.
350            client_kwargs: Additional keyword arguments for client initialization.
351
352        Returns:
353            QPulla: Pulse-level client bound to the backend.
354
355        Raises:
356            NotImplementedError: Software stack is not 'iqm', or the installed IQM stack
357                is not the IQM 36 one.
358            ValueError: Missing dynamic/static architecture.
359            QException: Installed IQM libraries do not match the backend.
360        """
361        backend = self.get_backend(
362            lexis_resource,
363            backend_name,
364            calibration_set_id,
365            strict_iqm_version=strict_iqm_version,
366            **client_kwargs,
367        )
368        if backend.iqm_stack is not IQMStack.IQM36:
369            raise NotImplementedError(
370                f"QPulla needs the IQM 36 stack (iqm-client 36.x, iqm-pulla 15.x); "
371                f"{backend.iqm_stack} is installed. Install it with: "
372                f"{install_hint(IQMStack.IQM36)}"
373            )
374
375        from .qpulla import QPulla
376
377        pulla = QPulla(
378            backend._qclient,
379            backend,
380            walltime_limit_secs=walltime_limit_secs,
381            job_name=job_name,
382            use_sessions=use_sessions,
383        )
384        backend.client = pulla
385        return pulla
386
387    def get_client(
388        self,
389        lexis_resource: str | QBackendMetadata | None = None,
390        backend_name: str | None = None,
391        **client_kwargs: Any,
392    ) -> QClient:
393        """Get a client bound to either the resource or specific backend.
394
395        Args:
396            lexis_resource: Either resource name or QBackendMetadata object.
397            backend_name: Optional backend name to specify if not using metadata.
398            client_kwargs: Additional keyword arguments for client initialization.
399
400        Returns:
401            QClient: Client instance bound to the specified target.
402        """
403        resource_name, name = _split_target(lexis_resource, backend_name)
404        client = self._get_client(resource_name, **client_kwargs)
405        return client.bind(name) if name is not None else client

QaaS wrapper for IQM backends with LEXIS token authentication.

Manages client connections and provides access to quantum computing resources. Each resource gets its own cached client that authenticates once and maintains machine information for all clusters of that resource. Backend instances are created by binding clients to specific backend names.

Attributes: _lexis_project: The Lexis project identifier. _token: Authentication token (auto-generated if not provided). _provider_token: Optional provider access token. _lexis_api_url: Base URL for Lexis API requests. _clients: Dictionary mapping resource names to QClient instances.

150        else:
151            self._session = None

class QSamplerJob(qiskit.primitives.base.base_primitive_job.BasePrimitiveJob[qiskit.primitives.containers.primitive_result.PrimitiveResult[qiskit.primitives.containers.sampler_pub_result.SamplerPubResult], qiskit.providers.jobstatus.JobStatus]): 
139class QSamplerJob(BasePrimitiveJob[PrimitiveResult[SamplerPubResult], JobStatus]):
140    """Job returned by :meth:`QSamplerV2.run`.
141
142    Wraps one :class:`~qheappe_client.qiskit.qbackend.QJob` per distinct shot count;
143    its id joins their HEAppE job ids with commas.
144    """
145
146    def __init__(
147        self,
148        pubs: list[SamplerPub],
149        groups: list[tuple[QJob, list[tuple[int, tuple[int, ...]]]]],
150    ):
151        """Create the job.
152
153        Args:
154            pubs (list[SamplerPub]): The coerced PUBs, in submission order.
155            groups (list): ``(backend job, [(pub index, bound shape), ...])`` per backend job.
156        """
157        super().__init__(",".join(job.job_id() for job, _ in groups))
158        self._pubs = pubs
159        self._groups = groups
160        self._result: PrimitiveResult[SamplerPubResult] | None = None
161
162    @property
163    def jobs(self) -> list[QJob]:
164        """The backend jobs behind this sampler job."""
165        return [job for job, _ in self._groups]
166
167    def result(self) -> PrimitiveResult[SamplerPubResult]:
168        """Wait for the backend jobs and return one ``SamplerPubResult`` per PUB.
169
170        Returns:
171            PrimitiveResult[SamplerPubResult]: Per PUB, a ``DataBin`` with one ``BitArray``
172            per classical register of the circuit, shaped like the PUB.
173
174        Raises:
175            RuntimeError: If a backend job fails or is canceled.
176            ValueError: If the measurement data does not match the circuits.
177        """
178        if self._result is not None:
179            return self._result
180
181        pub_results: list[SamplerPubResult | None] = [None] * len(self._pubs)
182        for job, entries in self._groups:
183            measurements = job._finished_artifacts(with_measurements=True)[
184                job._MEAS_ARTIFACT
185            ]
186            expected = sum(int(np.prod(shape, dtype=int)) for _, shape in entries)
187            if len(measurements) != expected:
188                raise ValueError(
189                    f"Job {job.job_id()}: {len(measurements)} measurement sets for "
190                    f"{expected} circuits"
191                )
192            start = 0
193            for i, shape in entries:
194                size = int(np.prod(shape, dtype=int))
195                pub_results[i] = _pub_result(
196                    self._pubs[i], shape, measurements[start : start + size], job
197                )
198                start += size
199
200        self._result = PrimitiveResult(pub_results, metadata={"version": 2})
201        return self._result
202
203    def status(self) -> JobStatus:
204        """Combined status of the backend jobs (the least advanced one wins)."""
205        statuses = {job.status() for job in self.jobs}
206        return next(s for s in _STATUS_PRIORITY if s in statuses)
207
208    def done(self) -> bool:
209        """Whether all backend jobs finished successfully."""
210        return self.status() == JobStatus.DONE
211
212    def running(self) -> bool:
213        """Whether any backend job is running."""
214        return self.status() == JobStatus.RUNNING
215
216    def cancelled(self) -> bool:
217        """Whether a backend job was canceled."""
218        return self.status() == JobStatus.CANCELLED
219
220    def in_final_state(self) -> bool:
221        """Whether the job is done, failed or canceled."""
222        return self.status() in JOB_FINAL_STATES
223
224    def wait_for_final_state(
225        self,
226        timeout: float | None = None,
227        wait: float = 5,
228        callback: Callable | None = None,
229    ) -> None:
230        """Wait until every backend job reaches a final state.
231
232        Follows the HEAppE event websocket of each backend job (see
233        :meth:`QJob.wait_for_final_state`), one job after another, sharing ``timeout``.
234
235        Args:
236            timeout (float | None): Seconds to wait in total. If ``None``, wait
237                indefinitely.
238            wait (float): Seconds between backup job-info queries.
239            callback (Callable | None): Called as ``callback(job_id, job_status, job)``
240                with this sampler job's id, combined status and the job itself,
241                whenever a backend job's status changes.
242
243        Raises:
244            JobTimeoutError: If the jobs do not reach a final state before the timeout.
245        """
246        deadline = None if timeout is None else time.monotonic() + timeout
247
248        def report(_job_id, _status, _job):
249            callback(self.job_id(), self.status(), self)
250
251        for job in self.jobs:
252            remaining = (
253                None if deadline is None else max(0.0, deadline - time.monotonic())
254            )
255            job.wait_for_final_state(
256                timeout=remaining, wait=wait, callback=report if callback else None
257            )
258
259    def cancel(self) -> None:
260        """Cancel all backend jobs."""
261        for job in self.jobs:
262            job.cancel()

Job returned by QSamplerV2.run().

Wraps one ~qheappe_client.qiskit.qbackend.QJob per distinct shot count; its id joins their HEAppE job ids with commas.

class QSamplerV2(qiskit.primitives.base.base_sampler.BaseSamplerV2): 
 46class QSamplerV2(BaseSamplerV2):
 47    """Sampler primitive (``SamplerV2``) that runs on a QaaS backend.
 48
 49    Each call to :meth:`run` binds the parameters of every PUB, submits all the
 50    resulting circuits as one backend job per distinct shot count, and returns a
 51    :class:`QSamplerJob` whose result is a ``PrimitiveResult``.
 52
 53    Circuits must already be transpiled for the backend (``backend.transpile(qc)``).
 54
 55    Example:
 56        >>> sampler = QSamplerV2(backend)
 57        >>> job = sampler.run([backend.transpile(qc)], shots=1000)
 58        >>> counts = job.result()[0].data.meas.get_counts()
 59    """
 60
 61    def __init__(
 62        self,
 63        backend: QBackend,
 64        *,
 65        default_shots: int | None = None,
 66        run_options: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
 67    ):
 68        """Create a sampler for ``backend``.
 69
 70        Args:
 71            backend (QBackend): The QaaS backend to run on.
 72            default_shots (int | None): Shots for PUBs that set none; the backend's
 73                ``shots`` option if ``None``.
 74            run_options (dict[str, Any] | None): Extra options passed to ``backend.run()``,
 75                e.g. ``job_name`` or ``circuit_compilation_options``.
 76        """
 77        self._backend = backend
 78        self._default_shots = default_shots
 79        self._run_options = dict(run_options or {})
 80
 81    @property
 82    def backend(self) -> QBackend:
 83        """The backend this sampler runs on."""
 84        return self._backend
 85
 86    @property
 87    def default_shots(self) -> int:
 88        """Shots used for PUBs that set none."""
 89        if self._default_shots is not None:
 90            return self._default_shots
 91        return int(self._backend.options.shots)
 92
 93    def run(
 94        self, pubs: Iterable[SamplerPubLike], *, shots: int | None = None
 95    ) -> QSamplerJob:
 96        """Submit PUBs and return a job for their results.
 97
 98        Args:
 99            pubs (Iterable[SamplerPubLike]): Circuits, or ``(circuit, parameter_values[, shots])`` tuples.
100            shots (int | None): Shots for PUBs that set none; :attr:`default_shots` if ``None``.
101
102        Returns:
103            QSamplerJob: Job whose :meth:`~QSamplerJob.result` is a ``PrimitiveResult``.
104
105        Raises:
106            ValueError: If a PUB circuit has no classical registers.
107        """
108        if shots is None:
109            shots = self.default_shots
110        coerced = [SamplerPub.coerce(pub, shots) for pub in pubs]
111        for i, pub in enumerate(coerced):
112            if not pub.circuit.cregs:
113                raise ValueError(
114                    f"PUB {i}: circuit has no classical registers, nothing to sample"
115                )
116
117        # One backend job per shot count (HEAppE takes one shot count per job).
118        by_shots: dict[int, list[int]] = {}
119        for i, pub in enumerate(coerced):
120            by_shots.setdefault(pub.shots, []).append(i)
121
122        groups = []
123        for group_shots, indices in by_shots.items():
124            bound = {
125                i: coerced[i].parameter_values.bind_all(coerced[i].circuit)
126                for i in indices
127            }
128            circuits: list[QuantumCircuit] = []
129            for i in indices:
130                circuits.extend(np.ravel(bound[i]).tolist())
131            job = self._backend.run(
132                circuits, shots=group_shots, memory=True, **self._run_options
133            )
134            groups.append((job, [(i, bound[i].shape) for i in indices]))
135
136        return QSamplerJob(coerced, groups)

Sampler primitive (SamplerV2) that runs on a QaaS backend.

Each call to run() binds the parameters of every PUB, submits all the resulting circuits as one backend job per distinct shot count, and returns a QSamplerJob whose result is a PrimitiveResult.

Circuits must already be transpiled for the backend (backend.transpile(qc)).

Example:

sampler = QSamplerV2(backend) job = sampler.run([backend.transpile(qc)], shots=1000) counts = job.result()[0].data.meas.get_counts()
